families.page_title: Hydrazine: general information and incident management
evidence_points: The official UKHSA page provides information on hydrazine for use when responding to chemical incidents.
The page is published by the UK Health Security Agency on GOV.UK.
The publication was first published on 1 July 2014.
The GOV.UK record shows a latest update of 10 March 2025.
The publication provides general information and incident management material.
The linked material supports substance-specific assessment of health effects, exposure and incident response for hydrazine.
Hydrazine is also known as diamide, diamine and nitrogen hydride.
The official page was live-opened successfully on 31 July 2026 and retained the title “Hydrazine: general information and incident management”.
